subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and product-wide explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this work as narrower memory-plugin and channel-plugin improvements?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses memory authority, storage shape, workspace-file precedence, plugin boundaries, and channel delivery policy; current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for this layer.

options.title: Keep as design tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and cross-channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split into narrower fixes
options.body: Handle Feishu self-mention and identity bugs in focused channel issues while opening a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that direction.

options.title: Route through plugin APIs first
options.body: Require a memory/plugin proof that existing APIs cannot support durable conversational rules before adding new core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep as design tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and cross-channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest cross-surface decision among the likely owners, spanning memory, core prompt authority, and channel behavior rather than only Feishu implementation details.
